issues.title: No 'Health bar' and 'Health' properties for new MilSymbol item
issues.body:
## 🐞 Bug description
Any MilSymbol item should has 'Health bar' and 'Health' properties 

## 🔢 Steps to Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Play game with data wargame-l6nngxlk
2. Click on channel 'Core Mapping'
3. Draw new item MilSymbol
4. Notice this new item MilSymbol doesn't have 'Health bar' and 'Health' properties 

![image](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/2deb7410-7d13-4a38-bf1a-7f2434f8c6f9)


## ⚙️ Expected behavior
Any MilSymbol item should has 'Health bar' and 'Health' properties

![image](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/804217fa-4e3c-4cff-b950-426ee74281c5)


## 🖥️ Screenshots
